name: api_projects_list
_description: GET /api/v1/projects - lista paginada cursor-based. Soporta filtros phase, q, status, sort.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details || $json._error, request_id: 'req_' + Date.now() } }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM v_project_summary WHERE status = COALESCE($1, status) AND ($2::text IS NULL OR current_phase = $2) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR current_phase = ANY(string_to_array($3, ','))) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR (lower(name) LIKE '%' || lower($4) || '%' OR lower(client_name) LIKE '%' || lower($4) || '%' OR lower(COALESCE(location_city,'')) LIKE '%' || lower($4) || '%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5 = 'created_asc' THEN created_at END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN $5 = 'created_desc' THEN created_at END DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN $5 = 'updated_asc' THEN updated_at END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN $5 = 'alphabetical' THEN name END ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN $5 NOT IN ('created_asc','created_desc','updated_asc','alphabetical') THEN updated_at END DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $6::int

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.status, $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.phase, $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.phase_in ? $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.phase_in.join(',') : null, $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.q, $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.sort, $('Decode JWT + Params').first().json.filters.limit + 1] }}
